subject: music
title: Chord Identification
welcome_lead: Major, minor, diminished, augmented — and 7th colours.
meta_desc: A-Level Music: identifying chord qualities and 7ths by ear.

concepts.def: Major triad + m7 (e.g. G B D F).
Diminished triad + m7 (e.g. B D F A).

walkthroughs.body_html: All triads are stacked thirds. Major = M3 + m3. Minor = m3 + M3. Diminished = m3 + m3. Augmented = M3 + M3.
Adding a 7th: major 7th on major triad (Cmaj7), dominant 7th on major + m7 (G7), minor 7th on minor + m7 (Dm7), half-diminished on dim + m7 (Bm7b5).
Listen for the third (mood) first, then check the fifth. Diminished and augmented chords have distinctive unstable colour — practise reproducing them at the piano daily.
